fixture_provenance: py_ecc 8.0.0 independently decodes selected compressed points, checks subgroup/recompression, converts affine coordinates to EIP-2537 form and checks the same aggregate result. Retained inputs/provenance in round2/api-curves/closest/.
name: closest_bls12_381_validate_g2_mops
notes: Closest mathematical operation with different input wire formats: plugin consumes canonical 96-byte IETF compressed G2 points; pure Motoko consumes canonical 256-byte EIP-2537 uncompressed G2 points (real then imaginary fields with 16-byte zero padding per field). Both validate curve/subgroup membership and return the same canonical compressed output. Compressed decoding also reconstructs y using a field square root; the uncompressed decoder does not perform that work. Input conversion between formats is independently prepared outside timing; timed pure code starts from its uncompressed Blob and includes Blob-to-array conversion, point validation, optional summation, compressed output and Result construction. Any ratio describes these explicitly different contracts, not equivalent API performance.
